content.text:
Generate a 3D model of an octopus chef at a ramen booth

Make it in Blender, working in the current directory.
- A Blender 5 instance is running for you with no window (background mode). Use it through the `blender`
  MCP tools: run Python (`bpy`) with execute_blender_code, and look things up with the API and manual
  search tools. Blender's working directory is the current directory. The scene starts as Blender's
  default one (a cube, a camera and a light).
- There is no window to screenshot. To check your work, render it to an image file and look at the image
  (render_thumbnail_to_path, render_viewport_to_path, or a render of the scene camera to a file).
  Keep renders quick: a single tool call may take at most 5 minutes.
- Build it in Blender itself; don't write the model or the images any other way.
- Save the finished result in ./output/ (only what is in ./output/ is published):
  - the model or scene as one .glb file (glTF binary), shown on the site in an interactive 3D viewer:
    `bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=..., export_format='GLB')`, without Draco or meshopt
    compression, at most 15 MB;
  - one or more final renders as .png or .jpg, at most 2 MB each, from camera angles you choose.
  At most 8 files in all.
- Tools available on this machine: python3 3.15.0 (standard library only), node 26.12.0 (no npm packages), ffmpeg 9.0.2, ffprobe 9.0.2. Don't install packages or download anything (no asset
  libraries or add-ons).
- Only create or edit files inside the current directory.
- Finish with a short summary of what you made.

import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector
for o in list(bpy.data.objects): bpy.data.objects.remove(o)
def mat(name,col,rough=0.5,em=0,metal=0):
    m=bpy.data.materials.new(name); m.use_nodes=True
    b=m.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF']
    b.inputs['Base Color'].default_value=(*col,1); b.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=rough; b.inputs['Metallic'].default_value=metal
    if em:
        b.inputs['Emission Color'].default_value=(*col,1); b.inputs['Emission Strength'].default_value=em
    return m
M=dict(skin=mat('skin',(0.85,0.25,0.35),0.35),belly=mat('belly',(0.95,0.6,0.6),0.4),white=mat('white',(0.95,0.95,0.92),0.6),
 black=mat('black',(0.02,0.02,0.03),0.2),wood=mat('wood',(0.35,0.18,0.08),0.7),dwood=mat('dwood',(0.18,0.09,0.05),0.8),
 red=mat('red',(0.7,0.08,0.06),0.6),steel=mat('steel',(0.7,0.7,0.72),0.3,0,1),broth=mat('broth',(0.8,0.5,0.15),0.2),
 noodle=mat('noodle',(0.95,0.8,0.4),0.5),green=mat('green',(0.2,0.55,0.15),0.6),lant=mat('lant',(1,0.35,0.1),0.5,4),
 floor=mat('floor',(0.3,0.28,0.26),0.9),blue=mat('blue',(0.1,0.2,0.45),0.7),egg=mat('egg',(1,0.85,0.5),0.4),pink=mat('pink',(1,0.55,0.6),0.4))
def fin(o,m,smooth=True):
    o.data.materials.append(M[m])
    if smooth and o.type=='MESH':
        for p in o.data.polygons: p.use_smooth=True
    return o
def sph(loc,s,m,seg=32):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(segments=seg,ring_count=seg//2,location=loc); o=bpy.context.object; o.scale=s; return fin(o,m)
def cyl(loc,r,h,m,rot=(0,0,0),v=32):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=v,radius=r,depth=h,location=loc,rotation=rot); return fin(bpy.context.object,m)
def box(loc,s,m,rot=(0,0,0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(location=loc,rotation=rot); o=bpy.context.object; o.scale=s; return fin(o,m,False)
def rod(a,b,r,m):
    a=Vector(a);b=Vector(b);d=b-a
    o=cyl((a+b)/2,r,d.length,m,v=12); o.rotation_euler=d.to_track_quat('Z','Y').to_euler(); return o
def tent(pts,r0,r1,m='skin'):
    cd=bpy.data.curves.new('t','CURVE'); cd.dimensions='3D'; cd.bevel_depth=1; cd.bevel_resolution=6; cd.use_fill_caps=True
    sp=cd.splines.new('BEZIER'); sp.bezier_points.add(len(pts)-1)
    n=len(pts)
    for i,(bp,p) in enumerate(zip(sp.bezier_points,pts)):
        bp.co=p; bp.handle_left_type=bp.handle_right_type='AUTO'; bp.radius=r0+(r1-r0)*(i/(n-1))
    sp.resolution_u=12
    o=bpy.data.objects.new('tentacle',cd); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o)
    bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=o; o.select_set(True)
    cd.materials.append(M[m]); bpy.ops.object.convert(target='MESH')
    o=bpy.context.object
    for p in o.data.polygons: p.use_smooth=True
    # suckers
    return o
# floor & booth
box((0,-0.5,-0.05),(5,4,0.05),'floor')
box((0,-2.7,2.2),(5,0.1,2.2),'dwood')
for x in(-2.7,2.7):
    box((x,0.8,2.2),(0.1,0.1,2.2),'wood'); box((x,-2.5,2.2),(0.1,0.1,2.2),'wood')
box((0,-0.9,4.5),(3.0,1.9,0.1),'red',(math.radians(-8),0,0))
box((0,0.8,4.35),(2.8,0.08,0.08),'wood')
# noren
for i in range(7):
    x=-2.1+i*0.7
    box((x,0.85,4.0),(0.3,0.015,0.38),'white' if i%2 else 'blue')
# counter
box((0,0.3,0.45),(2.6,0.6,0.45),'wood'); box((0,0.35,0.93),(2.7,0.7,0.04),'dwood')
box((0,0.9,0.5),(2.6,0.03,0.4),'red')
# shelf and bottles
box((0,-2.5,2.3),(2.3,0.2,0.04),'wood')
for i in range(9):
    x=-2+i*0.5; c=['red','green','blue','white'][i%4]
    cyl((x,-2.5,2.55),0.1,0.45,c,v=16)
box((0,-2.62,3.4),(1.0,0.03,0.3),'red')
# lantern
cyl((2.1,0.8,3.55),0.35,0.7,'lant'); cyl((2.1,0.8,3.95),0.37,0.06,'black'); cyl((2.1,0.8,3.15),0.37,0.06,'black')
rod((2.1,0.8,3.95),(2.1,0.8,4.3),0.02,'black')
# pot
cyl((-1.5,0.25,1.25),0.48,0.55,'steel'); cyl((-1.5,0.25,1.52),0.4,0.02,'broth')
sph((-1.0,0.2,1.05),(0.3,0.3,0.1),'steel')
# bowls
def bowl(c,top=True):
    x,y,z=c
    b=sph((x,y,z+0.2),(0.3,0.3,0.2),'white'); 
    sph((x,y,z+0.3),(0.27,0.27,0.08),'broth')
    sph((x,y,z+0.36),(0.2,0.2,0.07),'noodle')
    sph((x-0.08,y,z+0.42),(0.07,0.07,0.05),'egg'); cyl((x+0.1,y+0.05,z+0.43),0.08,0.02,'pink'); box((x+0.1,y-0.1,z+0.43),(0.1,0.03,0.01),'green')
bowl((0.9,0.35,0.95)); bowl((-0.2,0.5,0.95)); bowl((0.2,0.55,0.95)); 
# stools
for x in(-1.2,0.4,1.8): cyl((x,1.5,0.5),0.25,0.1,'wood'); cyl((x,1.5,0.25),0.06,0.5,'dwood',v=12)
# octopus
C=(0,-0.9,2.1)
sph(C,(0.7,0.65,0.85),'skin',48)
sph((0,-0.9,1.55),(0.55,0.5,0.4),'skin',32)
for x in(-0.27,0.27):
    sph((x,-1.9+1.57,2.05),(0.2,0.12,0.22),'white'); sph((x,-0.9+0.6-0.0+0.0+0.03,2.05),(0.2,0.12,0.22),'white')
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
for x in(-0.27,0.27):
    sph((x,-0.22,2.03),(0.09,0.05,0.12),'black'); sph((x+0.03,-0.17,2.1),(0.03,0.02,0.03),'white')
    sph((x*1.6,-0.35,1.78),(0.12,0.05,0.07),'pink')
# smile
cd=bpy.data.curves.new('smile','CURVE'); cd.dimensions='3D'; cd.bevel_depth=0.02
sp=cd.splines.new('BEZIER'); sp.bezier_points.add(2)
for bp,p in zip(sp.bezier_points,[(-0.15,-0.27,1.75),(0,-0.25,1.68),(0.15,-0.27,1.75)]):
    bp.co=p; bp.handle_left_type=bp.handle_right_type='AUTO'
o=bpy.data.objects.new('smile',cd); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o); cd.materials.append(M['black'])
# headband+hat
cyl((0,-0.9,3.0),0.52,0.32,'white'); 
cyl((0,-0.9,2.88),0.55,0.1,'red')
for dx,dy,dz,r in[(0,0,3.3,0.5),(0.3,0.05,3.35,0.35),(-0.3,0,3.35,0.35),(0,-0.3,3.35,0.35),(0,0.3,3.35,0.35),(0,0,3.6,0.4)]:
    sph((dx,-0.9+dy,dz),(r,r,r*0.9),'white')
# tentacles
tent([(0.35,-0.7,1.5),(0.9,-0.4,1.4),(1.35,0.0,1.4),(1.25,0.35,1.2),(1.05,0.4,1.1)],0.17,0.05)
tent([(-0.35,-0.7,1.5),(-0.8,-0.55,1.6),(-1.1,-0.4,2.0),(-1.15,-0.1,2.2)],0.17,0.06)
tent([(0.4,-0.9,1.5),(1.0,-0.95,1.9),(1.4,-0.9,2.5),(1.2,-0.8,3.0),(0.9,-0.7,3.1)],0.17,0.04)
tent([(-0.4,-0.9,1.5),(-1.0,-1.0,1.9),(-1.5,-1.0,2.5),(-1.7,-1.0,3.0),(-1.45,-1.0,3.3)],0.17,0.04)
tent([(0.45,-1.1,1.4),(1.2,-1.4,0.9),(1.9,-1.2,0.2),(2.4,-0.8,0.1)],0.17,0.04)
tent([(-0.45,-1.1,1.4),(-1.2,-1.4,0.9),(-1.9,-1.2,0.2),(-2.4,-0.8,0.1)],0.17,0.04)
tent([(0.2,-1.3,1.4),(0.5,-1.8,0.8),(0.9,-2.0,0.2),(1.4,-1.7,0.1)],0.16,0.04)
tent([(-0.2,-1.3,1.4),(-0.5,-1.8,0.8),(-0.9,-2.0,0.2),(-1.4,-1.7,0.1)],0.16,0.04)
# ladle
rod((-1.15,-0.1,2.2),(-1.45,0.2,1.55),0.03,'steel'); sph((-1.47,0.22,1.5),(0.12,0.12,0.08),'steel')
# chopsticks + noodles
rod((0.9,-0.7,3.1),(0.55,-0.1,3.3),0.015,'wood'); rod((0.93,-0.65,3.15),(0.6,-0.05,3.35),0.015,'wood')
# lighting
bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='SUN',location=(3,4,6),rotation=(math.radians(50),0,math.radians(150))); bpy.context.object.data.energy=3
bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='POINT',location=(2.1,0.5,3.5)); l=bpy.context.object; l.data.energy=300; l.data.color=(1,0.5,0.25)
bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='AREA',location=(0,2,3.5)); l=bpy.context.object; l.data.energy=250; l.data.size=4; l.rotation_euler=(math.radians(-60),0,0) if False else (math.radians(60),0,math.pi)
bpy.ops.object.camera_add(location=(3.2,6.2,2.6)); c=bpy.context.object
c.rotation_euler=(Vector((0,-0.3,2.0))-c.location).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler(); c.data.lens=35
bpy.context.scene.camera=c
s=bpy.context.scene; s.render.engine='BLENDER_EEVEE'; s.render.resolution_x=1280; s.render.resolution_y=800
w=bpy.data.worlds.new('w'); w.use_nodes=True; w.node_tree.nodes['Background'].inputs[0].default_value=(0.05,0.06,0.1,1); s.world=w
s.render.filepath='//output/render.png'
import os; os.makedirs('output',exist_ok=True)
bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
